cards.example_en: The editor moved my photo to the front page of the school paper.
cards.example_zh: 编辑把我的照片放到了校报头版。

cards.example_en: The educator spoke about reading habits.
cards.example_zh: 这位教育工作者谈了阅读习惯。

cards.example_en: This is an efficient way to learn new words.
cards.example_zh: 这是学习新单词的有效方法。

cards.example_en: An elderly neighbour waters our plants whenever we travel.
cards.example_zh: 我们外出时，一位年长的邻居会给植物浇水。

cards.example_en: The election for team captain will be a secret vote on Thursday.
cards.example_zh: 队长选举定在星期四，采用无记名投票。

cards.example_en: Lightning cut the electricity, and we finished dinner by torchlight.
cards.example_zh: 闪电把电切断了，我们打着手电筒吃完了晚餐。

cards.example_en: She wore an elegant black dress.
cards.example_zh: 她穿了一条优雅的黑裙子。

cards.example_en: Iron is the element that makes blood able to carry oxygen.
cards.example_zh: 铁这种元素让血液能够携带氧气。

cards.example_en: Let's sit elsewhere.
cards.example_zh: 我们坐到别处去吧。

cards.example_en: She felt embarrassed when her phone rang in the quiet library.
cards.example_zh: 她的手机在安静的图书馆里响了，她觉得很尴尬。

cards.example_en: The moon will emerge from behind the clouds tonight.
cards.example_zh: 今晚月亮会从云层后面露出来。

cards.example_en: The song is full of emotion.
cards.example_zh: 这首歌充满情感。

cards.example_en: The course puts emphasis on speaking.
cards.example_zh: 课程强调口语。

cards.example_en: The shop will employ two new workers.
cards.example_zh: 这家商店将雇用两名新员工。

cards.example_en: This card will enable you to borrow library books.
cards.example_zh: 这张卡能让你借阅图书馆的书。

cards.example_en: You may encounter new words in the text.
cards.example_zh: 你可能会在课文里遇到生词。

cards.example_en: Our club members engage in team sports after lessons.
cards.example_zh: 课后，我们的社团成员会参加团队运动。

cards.example_en: Smoke from the engine forced the driver to pull off the road.
cards.example_zh: 发动机冒烟，司机只好把车停到路边。

cards.example_en: Songs and films enhance our spoken English after school.
cards.example_zh: 放学后，歌曲和电影能提高我们的英语口语。

cards.example_en: They live in an enormous house.
cards.example_zh: 他们住在一栋巨大的房子里。

cards.example_en: Ensure the front door is locked when you leave.
cards.example_zh: 离开的时候，一定要确认前门已经锁好。

cards.example_en: The enterprise makes school uniforms.
cards.example_zh: 这家企业生产校服。

cards.example_en: The hotel offers evening entertainment.
cards.example_zh: 酒店提供夜间娱乐活动。

cards.example_en: He is enthusiastic about science.
cards.example_zh: 他对科学很热情。

cards.example_en: That story is entirely true.
cards.example_zh: 那个故事完全是真的。

cards.example_en: A student ticket will entitle you to a cheaper seat.
cards.example_zh: 持学生票可以买到更便宜的座位。

cards.example_en: Meet me at the main entrance.
cards.example_zh: 在正门与我见面。

cards.example_en: Write a new entry in your diary.
cards.example_zh: 在日记里写一条新内容。

cards.example_en: Put the letter in an envelope.
cards.example_zh: 把信放进信封。

cards.example_en: I felt a little envy when I saw her prize.
cards.example_zh: 看到她的奖品时我有点羡慕。

cards.example_en: I recorded the last episode so I could watch it after training.
cards.example_zh: 我把最后一集录了下来，好在训练结束后看。

cards.example_en: Both teams had equal numbers of players after the change.
cards.example_zh: 调整之后，两队的球员人数相等。

cards.example_en: Countries near the equator are hot.
cards.example_zh: 赤道附近的国家很热。

cards.example_en: You don't need much equipment to go running.
cards.example_zh: 您不需要太多设备就可以跑步。

cards.example_en: An error in the timetable sent our class to the wrong room.
cards.example_zh: 时间表上的一处错误让我们班走错了教室。

cards.example_en: The volcano may erupt again.
cards.example_zh: 这座火山可能再次喷发。

cards.example_en: The hamster tried to escape from its small cage.
cards.example_zh: 那只仓鼠试图从自己的小笼子里逃走。

cards.example_en: I rewrote the essay after I noticed the conclusion did not match the question.
cards.example_zh: 我发现结论和题目对不上，就把这篇作文重写了。

cards.example_en: Water is essential for life.
cards.example_zh: 水对生命至关重要。

cards.example_en: The school will establish a new reading club.
cards.example_zh: 学校将成立一个新的阅读社团。

cards.example_en: The old estate on the hill includes a house, an orchard, and woods.
cards.example_zh: 山上那片古老的产业有房子、果园和树林。

cards.example_en: They estimate the trip will take three hours.
cards.example_zh: 他们估计行程需要3个小时。

cards.example_en: We need to evaluate the results of the test.
cards.example_zh: 我们需要评估测试结果。

cards.example_en: We met on the eve of the exam.
cards.example_zh: 我们在考试前夕见了面。

cards.example_en: We eventually found the key.
cards.example_zh: 我们最终找到了钥匙。

cards.example_en: Footprints in the flour were evidence that the dog had been on the counter.
cards.example_zh: 面粉上的爪印就是狗上过台面的证据。

cards.example_en: The doctor will examine your sore throat today.
cards.example_zh: 医生今天会检查你疼痛的喉咙。

cards.example_en: Her drawing is exceptional.
cards.example_zh: 她的画非常出色。

cards.example_en: Our exchange with the Japanese club included songs and handwritten letters.
cards.example_zh: 我们和日本社团的交流包括歌曲和亲笔信。

cards.example_en: The art exhibition opens on Friday.
cards.example_zh: 美术展览周五开幕。

word.example_en: The two teams are equal in strength.
She is equal to the editing task.
word.example_zh: 她能胜任这项编辑工作。

word.example_en: Trust is essential to a project team.
word.example_zh: 信任对项目组至关重要。

word.example_en: Water is essential for the seedlings.
